title: First Index
statement: Implement `solve(items, target)`. Return the smallest index `i` such that `items[i] == target`. If the target is absent, return -1. A later duplicate does not matter.
constraints: items is a list of strings
hints: Return as soon as you see the target.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Linear search returns the first hit.

editorial: Linear search returns the first hit. Continuing after a match would find the last index instead, which is a different function. -1 is the conventional missing index because 0 is a valid hit.
